realtime_memories.content: User works across multiple bot files (newDifferX2.js, accurateDiffer.js, newRiseFall.js, accuPULSE3.js, bizPattern.js, accuAPEXnew.js, accuPULSE2b.js). Prefer porting working patterns between files rather than re-deriving. Config uses GMT/UTC day clock and env-var-overridable CONFIG entries (boolEnv/strEnv/numEnv/intEnv pattern). All bot credentials hardcoded in CONFIG (no .env migration).

newDifferX2.js v4: frequency strategy default (falsifiable); deviation gate minDeviationZ=4.2 with min-of-10 on fair-Bernoulli z; recovery OFF by default; circuit breaker ON (4 losses); calibrator ON (window 200, minTrades 40); dailyMaxTrades=300; reconcile on reconnect, never clear exec.open; exec.sell() must exist; lastBalance = balanceAfter + profit + stake; selftest verifies 0 phantom signals.

AccuAPEXnew v4: Reconcile open contracts after every re-auth; idempotent settlement via _settledIds; single-flight entry latch _tradeInFlight; VOL compression = recent-MAD / long-baseline-MAD (not EWMA ratio); growth-rate grid [0.05,0.04,0.03,0.02,0.01]; hard daily caps (60 trades / $500 loss); CLI flags --selftest and --dry-run.

bizPattern.js v2: Wilson lower bound REMOVED as trade gate (only reported as confidenceLower) — using it made trading impossible on n≈20-60 samples; holdout comparison is THE anti-overfit check; BUY_SYMBOL_FIELD must be 'auto' (resolves to 'underlying_symbol' for PAT/OTP); DURATION must equal GRANULARITY (60s/60s); martingale user-re-enabled (preserve user config edits).

accuPULSE2b AEBA v2: Gate = hard EV net of costs; EV(g) = (1+g)·p̂ − 1 − costHaircut; g chosen by argmax EV; survival floor S(K) ≥ survivalFloor; vol-of-vol percentile gate. Barrier from live tick_size_barrier_percentage per growth-rate bucket — never fabricate. P0: do NOT clear exec.open on disconnect; reconcile on re-auth; entry gated on this.reconciled. dailyMaxTrades=40. Selftest: 8 checks, no network.

newDifferX2.js pause + DOW fix: _schedulePause() was defined but never called — pause windows never fired. Fix: call this.paused = this._isPausedNow() + this._schedulePause() in _onAuthorized. Day-of-week filter ported from accurateDiffer.js: CONFIG tradeSunday..tradeSaturday (env-overridable), _isTradingAllowedToday() checks getUTCDay(). All times GMT/UTC. Both filters independent and stack.

accuPULSE3 v5.0 built 2026-08-15 (accuPULSE3_v5.js, 2875 lines). 7 features: (1) adaptive confidence gates by vol regime (0.01-0.08); (2) 6-factor stake sizing (Kelly, confidence, vol, WR, DD, streak); (3) 6-check entry confirmation (≥4/6 pass); (4) 4-tier exit (3/8/15/20 ticks, scale-out 30%); (5) warm-up lifecycle WARMUP→BALANCED→OPTIMIZED; (6) graduated recovery (WR-based multipliers, no hard pause); (7) full metrics JSONL logging. v4.0 had 6 critical blockers causing 1 trade/48h. Worktree agent lesson: always commit base changes before spawning worktree agents.
